narrative.overview: Soft cherry-blossom pinks on a warm paper ground with deep plum ink text. Rounded, quiet, slightly translucent surfaces; calm reading room for anime and manga. Persian and RTL are native.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper background with faint radial blooms
Rounded forms (14px controls, 20px panels, pill chips)

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Sakura Rose is the only saturated color; it marks what is actionable or current and stays rare on any screen.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals carry a trace of plum; no pure grey or black in light theme; dark theme stays plum.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second typeface; vary weight and size instead.

rules.name: The Persian Digit Rule
rules.body: Numbers shown to users go through formatNumber(value, lang).

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with plum and stay faint; nothing casts a hard or grey shadow.

dos: Do use tokens and dark-theme counterparts instead of raw colors.
Do build with RTL logical properties and keep Persian as the primary voice.
Do keep touch targets at least 24px (44px for main mobile actions) and labels matching visible text.
Do keep motion light and short; respect reduced motion.
Do keep sensitive-content covers behind the user toggle.
donts: Don't imitate the dense, dated look of old MyAnimeList.
Don't add neon or high-saturation glow to the dark theme.
Don't add heavy or decorative animation.
Don't add a second typeface or hard-coded colors.
Don't use grey or black shadows.
